name: Tucson
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Tucson for 2026, and here is what he found: 37 family events, 17 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (LightsUp at Tucson Botanical Gardens and Yuletide at Old Tucson) through January 10, 2027 (ZooLights at Reid Park Zoo and LightsUp), with the Downtown Parade of Lights and Festival (December 5), the Presidio card-making workshop (December 13), the Winterhaven Festival of Lights (December 12 to 26) and Ballet Tucson's The Nutcracker (December 18 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Tucson

  • 37 Christmas events for kids in Tucson
  • 17 free events, including the Downtown Parade of Lights and Festival, the Winterhaven Festival of Lights, Festive Fridays at Trail Dust Town, Winter Wonderland at AC Hotel Downtown Tucson, the Westin La Paloma tree lighting and the Park Place Mall Holiday Block Party
  • Meet Santa: Santa at Harlow Gardens, ZooLights at Reid Park Zoo, Yuletide at Old Tucson, the Christmas Balloon Glow at Pima Air and Space Museum and Winter Wonderland at AC Hotel Downtown Tucson
  • Parades and tree lightings: Downtown Parade of Lights and Festival (December 5) and the Christmas Tree Lighting and Holiday Open House at the Arizona Inn (November 29)
  • Trains: the Christmas Express train ride at Festive Fridays at Trail Dust Town (November 27 and December 4, 11 and 18)
  • Season: November 27 to January 10, 2027
